notes: BLOCKED: this manifest is schema-valid but deploys only the accepted LaunchToken (COMP Launch / CPL / 18 decimals, no constructor arguments, 10^27 minor units minted to the factory) plus the factory's LP and MerkleDistributor. It does not deploy the requested feed/oracle/vault increment, and the empty contracts list is not approval of that increment. The evm_project kind and the protected token floor require a launch token while the approved workflow states that no token is deployed; that conflict is a review and policy finding, not something this manifest can resolve. Pool: CPL against native ETH, fee 3000, tickSpacing 60, no hook, initialPrice as decimal sqrtPriceX96; the pinned policy may derive the effective opening price. Why the increment is not listed. (1) The workflow needs two SwarmFeed instances differing only by constructor words. The accepted tree exposes exactly one artifact named SwarmFeed (src/SwarmFeed.sol) and no PriceFeed or NhiFeed name; manifest identifiers must be unique and there is no alias field, so listing SwarmFeed twice fails validation (reproduced locally). Passing one shared feed as both priceFeed_ and nhiFeed_ is accepted by the CDPVault constructor, which has no equality guard, and couples the channels: a 0.5e18 price is read as NHI 0.5, giving minCR 200 and zero grace (reproduced locally). (2) Approved immutable questionHash values for the price and NHI questions, and maxAge and maxDeviationBps for each feed, appear nowhere in the tree or the workflow; only the attester 0x5598aa9146215bc13eb26f2c692ad1461fd32982 and a 3600 s attestation TTL are given. Test fixture values are not deployment inputs. maxAge is also a liquidation parameter: CDPVault.liquidationWindow() is the smaller of the two feeds' maxAge and bounds how long an elapsed mark stays actionable. (3) MockWorkOracle takes only the vault and pins grantRights to the operator in src/DeploymentConfig.sol; no constructor consumes $owner. (4) docs/abi/CDPVault.json still exports the retired three-argument constructor and there is no SwarmFeed ABI export. Manifest to be written once source owners deliver two separately named feed artifacts (for example PriceFeed and NhiFeed deriving from SwarmFeed) and the approved feed values, in dependency order: PriceFeed(attester, priceQuestionHash, $owner, 0x0, 0x0, 1, priceMaxAge, priceMaxDeviationBps); NhiFeed(attester, nhiQuestionHash, $owner, 0x0, 0x0, 1, nhiMaxAge, nhiMaxDeviationBps); CDPVault(0x5e223eb2ea5d55b4a8d4190e94df3524b58dfc79, 0x70bc53314feac5251274ef65e49fd11c0d679bfe, 0x0, $contract:PriceFeed, $contract:NhiFeed). The zero oracle argument makes the vault create and permanently bind a fresh MockWorkOracle in its own constructor, so no separate oracle entry is needed. Neither existing token is redeployed. $owner is the only reference permitted in the reporter slot; the workflow's sole reporter is the deployer 0x5167d014a056e43883e1bbea5530c3c0dc993281, so the policy owner must equal that address or the fallback reporter path is unusable. Post-deployment dependency outside any manifest: CompToken must receive one setVault(newVault) call from its initializer. Observed on Sepolia through a public RPC on 2026-09-30: CompToken 0x70bc53314feac5251274ef65e49fd11c0d679bfe vault() is zero and its initializer slot holds 0x5167d014a056e43883e1bbea5530c3c0dc993281; MockIMD 0x5e223eb2ea5d55b4a8d4190e94df3524b58dfc79 deployer() is the same address. That authorization is available but irreversible and must target the vault this launch actually deploys. No initialization calls are specified here. Notes are explanatory, not deployment authority; services own policy, signed artifact linkage, attestation, admission, deployment and frontend startup.
